title: This Netflix Merger Changes Everything
description:
Netflix’s own CEO admits the goal is to “upset people” and “shift the Overton window," not entertain, but slowly erode standards. Now they’re trying to swallow Warner Bros and control a massive chunk of Hollywood, from HBO to DC to Harry Potter.

If the people behind Cuties and Queen of Coal get a near-monopoly on culture, what do you think comes next?
